numbers.source: DECLARED ILLUSTRATION — representative 12 LPA CTC structure (DEMO tag from beat 1, never frame 0)
DEMO structure: variable pay 15% of CTC — typical Indian IT/services band
DEMO structure: PF = 12% of basic (basic ₹4,80,000 = 40% of CTC) — statutory rate, applied twice (employer + employee)
DEMO structure: gratuity accrual 4.81% of basic — statutory formula
DEMO structure: group insurance premium — typical band

REAL-SOURCED: new regime FY 2025-26 — taxable ₹8,49,312 after ₹75k standard deduction < ₹12,00,000 rebate threshold (s87A ₹60,000, Budget 2025) → tax NIL. Verified 2026-08-22: tax2win.in/guide/section-87a, taxclue.in/new-tax-regime-2025-26
derived on screen: sum of the carted chunks 1,80,000+57,600+57,600+23,088+15,000+2,400 — closes to the rupee
the rebate threshold in lakh — real-sourced (see tax 0 entry)

carry: the SALARY BRICK itself — whole at beat 1, chopped smaller every beat, the surviving wafer becomes the SMS amount; secondary carry = the hand-cart accumulating the chunks (its lineup IS the circle-close).

give.prompt: Break my CTC of ₹____ into real monthly in-hand (new tax regime FY 2025-26). List EVERY deduction as a line item — employer PF, employee PF, gratuity, variable pay held back, professional tax, income tax after standard deduction and 87A rebate. Then tell me the ONE line I should negotiate in my next offer, and what it is worth per month.
give.where: description above the fold + pinned comment

outro.cta: The CTC-decoder prompt is pinned and in the description. Apna CTC daalo — apna sach nikaalo. Free.
